text:
alex: hey all — day 1 kit arrived but a few annoyances before standup :(

alex: 1) power brick is the EU two-pin plug, i'm in SF and only have US outlets.
alex: 2) external webcam shipped with a stuck privacy shutter — won't open. tried gentle pressure but it's jammed. opened TKT-22560.
alex: 3) connected to Redwood-Guest just fine but when i try internal wiki it redirects to a captive login page that says "device not registered".

sara-onboarding: welcome alex!! :tada: tagging IT + ops. sorry about the plug. @nina-ops can we stage a US power adapter for pickup or ship?

nina-ops: yep we keep universal adapter kits. @alex do you want to pick up from locker 3 (code 0882) or should we courier? pickup is fastest.
alex: pickup please — i'll be in the office in ~20m. thanks nina.

ivan-it: hi alex, welcome. for the captive message — is this on the company SSID or guest? you mentioned Guest; Guest won't allow internal resources. Can you try connecting to "Redwood-Onsite" and if it prompts for a device cert follow the steps in the welcome doc. If it still says unregistered, run:
```
# macOS: check enrollment
profiles status
# Windows: run in PowerShell as admin
Get-WmiObject -Namespace root\cimv2\mdm -Class MDM_EnrollmentStatus
```

alex: i'm on macOS Ventura 13.4 — used Guest because Onsite didn't show up earlier. ran `profiles status` and it says no profiles.

ivan-it: ok that explains the captive issue. i'll re-send the MDM push and attach the cert profile. you should get a prompt to install within 10 minutes. after installing, switch to Redwood-Onsite and reboot.

warehouse-bot: [automated] Reserved: 1 US power adapter (Type A) for alex in Locker 3 (code 0882). Return unused accessories within 14 days.

nina-ops: alex — locker 3 updated. code on the sticker is 0882. note: adapter kit is labelled "new-hires".

alex: grabbed the adapter, fits fine — thanks!!

alex: for the webcam shutter: i tried prying with a fingernail and don't want to risk breaking it. any safe trick?

ivan-it: some models have a tiny catch — try pressing the shutter toward the lens (not pulling) while sliding with your thumb, sometimes it disengages. but if it's glued or broken we can swap. can you open System Settings > Camera and see if the device is recognized at all?

alex: Camera settings shows the webcam model "LogiCam M100" but the preview is black (shutter closed).

ivan-it: ok software sees it, so it's mechanical. nina — can ops leave a spare external webcam (Logi C270) in locker 3 as backup? If alex prefers, we can ship overnight.

nina-ops: spare webcam placed in locker 3 alongside adapter.

alex: tried the press+slide trick, shutter popped open! camera preview now works. :relieved: thanks for the tip.

ivan-it: awesome. how about the MDM push — did you get a prompt?

alex: yes a profile prompt appeared, installed, rebooted. switched to Redwood-Onsite and internal wiki loads now. confirmed I can access Confluence and internal git.

ivan-it: great. i've updated TKT-22560: resolution summary — ops locker pickup for adapter, mechanical shutter freed (user), MDM re-push resolved captive issue. closing unless you want ops to ship replacement webcam.

alex: no need to ship, everything's green. really appreciate the fast help! :thumbsup:
sara-onboarding: welcome again alex! ping me if you want a quick intro to the team or help with repo access later.
alex: will do, thanks everyone :)
